title: A/P Summary: a link naming several locations or every location
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open A/P documents at three locations, {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, untick {Location-C}.
  2. Copy the page address.
  3. Paste the address into a new tab.
  4. In the Location menu, tick {Location-C} again.
  5. Look at the page address.
  6. In the copied address, add {Location-C} to the listed locations, separated by a comma, and open it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report narrows to {Location-A} and {Location-B}.
  • Step 2: the address carries the two ticked locations.
  • Step 3: the report opens with {Location-A} and {Location-B} ticked ("Location: 2 locations").
  • Step 4: every location is ticked.
  • Step 5: with every location ticked the address no longer lists locations.
  • Step 6: a link naming every location opens as "Location: All locations".

The tester copies the address after ticking and edits only the list of locations in it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R10: “The ticked locations are kept in the page address while fewer than all are ticked, so browser Back, a reload and a shared link restore them; a link listing several locations separated by commas is read as those locations. "No locations" is not kept in the address: a reload or shared link opens on All locations, as on Sales By Customer. A link naming every location reads as All locations.”
